item: Chromium walk of the 0.5 screens: dossier keyword route, Explore subtab scroll, Arabic Latin names, borders follow the zoom
summary: Walked rows A, G, I, D, E/L and K in English and Arabic on seeded data. Fixed the dossier keyword route (it read the empty legacy article_keywords table, now keyword_mentions), the Explore subtab click landing thousands of pixels below the fold, and Latin source names clipping in Arabic. Borders: at a realistic size the country outlines had no draw budget and coordinates were rounded to about 5 km, so no zoom could show the file's detail; the budget is now per view (what is in sight), decimals grow with the zoom and outlines out of sight return to the coarse world outline. The load and parse cost of the whole border files is not fixed here.
